note: NO RULING IS MADE HERE. Every founder_decision field is null and stays null until a human fills it. This packet exists because the market's boundary was, in seven places, decided by whether a municipality string happened to appear in a corridor's included_cities list -- which is a data-entry fact, not a geography ruling. 9 properties sit behind these seven names: 8 currently excluded and 1 already admitted. Under the market's declared MARKET_GEOGRAPHY basis a candidate in one of these municipalities whose coordinates fall inside the bounds is BORDERLINE and is held MARKET_MEMBERSHIP_UNRESOLVED for review -- it is not silently dropped, and it is not silently admitted either. Three further municipalities were surfaced by the shadow recensus and appended: Farmington Hill (an OSM spelling variant of the registered Farmington Hills), Farmington, and Plymouth Township. Together the ten names account for all 24 MARKET_MEMBERSHIP_UNRESOLVED candidates the shadow run produced.
